source: Genuine Qwen output with its low-contrast literal gradient; this QA run also injected an invalid row translation. Captured 2026-10-19.
instruction: Make a professional League of Legends overlay inspired by an LEC broadcast. Use teal for the left team, burnt orange for the right, and layered charcoal surfaces. Give the team sections a visible but tasteful gradient. Keep the top scoreboard compact, with prominent scores and a clear clock in the middle. Along the bottom, use tightly packed player tables with items toward the outside and names and stats toward the middle. Champion portraits should be slightly bigger than item icons. Use bold condensed lettering, restrained accents and subtle row separators. Give it a coherent visual identity while keeping the gameplay and minimap clear.
